_about: editor-runtime: sections from the plain-pages audit (2026-09-27). Saving and tabs, the file tree, editing, four terminal groups and the search index; big-file limits and rarely changed terminal and index options under More options. The page is named Editor & Terminal: its containers moved to Containers. Duplicate hand rows are dropped: format-save (Tidy code automatically, Toolchain), large-file (the three inventory size limits), terminal-profile (Shell), terminal-restore (Terminals when a project reopens), index-exclusions (Leave out of search). In: tabs reopened next time, from App & Input.
